notes: v230 — DSP-MULTI-SEND (owner, Oct 22, 2026 21:13 MDT: dispatchers send a dispatch to MULTIPLE drivers at once — the send flow gets a check-off list of their drivers; tick, one send, lands for every driver ticked; queued behind the Connect fix, shipped v226–v229). THE CHANGE (js/connectpipe.js + modules/dispatch.js only): (1) CP.sendDispatchToMany(peerUids, fields) fans the SAME composed dispatch out through the untouched CP.sendDispatch — one pipedispatches doc per ticked driver, byte-identical to a single send (same fields, same pin ride, same one-time stamp), resolving a PER-DRIVER verdict {sent, failed} in tick order; duplicate ticks collapse, an empty list is an honest no-op. (2) The Dispatch compose card's Driver dropdown is now a CHECK-OFF LIST of the sender's connected drivers — who is offered is unchanged (the v155 face law: 'driver'/'both' faces only; office and faceless peers get no box). One Send press collects the ticked uids and calls the fan-out. The result line is honest per driver: one sent = 'Sent to NAME ✓'; all sent = the count plus every name; partial = sent names ✓ then 'NOT sent to NAME: check the connection, then tick him and send again'; none = the shipped could-not-send line with 'Nothing was sent.' The tick-first validation replaces the pick-first line ('Tick at least one driver, pick the date, and add the job site first — nothing was sent.'). RECEIVER SIDE UNTOUCHED: each driver's pullInbox lands his own copy exactly as a single send lands today (filed by the dispatch's own date, pin aboard, conflict flag, receipt ticks). The Connect screen's per-connection share of an EXISTING dispatch stays single, as shipped; a driver's own account still cannot send. No rules change: every fan-out doc is an ordinary sender-created 'sent' doc the existing pipedispatches rules already allow. NAMED CHOICES (design authority — minimal, his to overrule): NO tick-all button (the send card has never had a select-all pattern, and a crew-wide send stays a deliberate tick per driver); with exactly ONE connected driver his box starts ticked (parity with the dropdown, which always had him picked); with several, none start ticked. REPRODUCTION-FIRST: new tools/dispatch-multi-send-test.js (45 checks) drives the REAL connectlive/connectpipe + the DSP-PIPE region of dispatch.js over a fake Firestore with per-recipient fault injection and phone-like user worlds — RED before the fix on the exact feature gap (no check-off list, no fan-out, the card's line was the old pick-first validation), GREEN after (45/45): the list offers exactly the driving peers in connection order; two-of-three ticked lands exactly two single-send-shaped docs and both drivers pull their own copies in while the unticked driver gets nothing; the single-send regression holds (sendDispatch untouched, fan-out of one = the same send, byte-identical doc shape incl. the pin); a rejected write to one driver yields the per-driver verdict and a card line naming him NOT sent while the others land; validation writes zero docs. The v155 picker harness and the v147 name harness had their markup probes moved to the tick list with supersede notes (the laws they verify are unchanged). REGRESSIONS: full-suite fail set identical to the pristine v229 baseline (boss-firstrun 2, background-day 3, chatbot 2, connect-pipe's parked stale key-set pin 1, fix-batch-v222 1, loads-gps-fix-v203 crash, native-track 1, nav-gesture-plane 6, nav-gestures 5, navigator-screen 1, navigator-v139 2, navigator 2, pti-dash 1, role-package 3 — all pre-existing); connect family green (connect-share 96/96, connect-pick 61/61, connect-kinds 107/107, connect-live 85/85, connect-namespace 27/27, umar-connect-blank 64/64, umar-connect-viability 120/120). Standing pin move 229 -> 230 across index.html and the test files. Native unchanged (v40 OTA pointer carries it). Machine-green is preparation — the final verdict is a dispatcher ticking two drivers and pressing Send once: both phones gain the job, and a driver whose write fails is named on the card, not silently dropped. Parked untouched (named, not built): SHIFT-CLOSE-DUP-ENTRY; the 'Sent by you' list still does not name each dispatch's recipient (pre-existing paint, unchanged).
